messages:
elaine: opened a PR to update the model catalog for Horizon-7B — fixes seq limits, clarifies compatibility notes, and adds example snippets. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/12890
sam: quick q — did we confirm max_context for 16k vs 32k fallbacks? runtime needs a clear statement in the card
marco: did a quick microbench today, gist with numbers here: https://gist.github.com/marco/bench-h7b — includes 2k/8k/16k runs and memory footprints
elaine: dropping the primary example here so it’s in the PR too:
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key="$REDWOOD_KEY")
resp = client.generate(model="horizon-7b", prompt="Summarize the notes...", max_tokens=200)
print(resp.text)
```
rik: can we add a short note about quantized CPU fallback behavior? support keeps seeing OOMs when people assume 32k on CPU quantized
sam: agree — propose a one-liner under Compatibility: "quantized-cpu fallback supports up to 4k seq; larger contexts require GPU-backed variants or dedicated capacity."
olivia: product wants bench numbers inline (small table) not just external gist links — can we add 95th pct latency + tokens/sec rows
marco: sure, I'll embed a compact table into the PR (CSV attached in the PR) — ETA EOD
elaine: also spotted a broken link in the card: the "Model variants" anchor points to /models/horizon-7b#variants but currently 404s — will fix in PR
docs-bot: preview deployed for PR 12890: https://deploy.preview.redwood/docs/changes/12890 — please review :white_check_mark:
sam: small SDK tweak — added streaming vs batching note in the example to avoid misconfiguring clients for low-latency use cases
elaine: thanks — I will wait for marco's table and rik's OK on the compat note, then merge
rik: okay from runtime side, adding compat snippet for fallback policy:
```yaml
fallback_policy:
  - prefer: gpu-variant
  - fallback: quantized-cpu (max_context: 4096)
```
marco: pushed bench table + CSV to the PR, included 95th pct and median rows
elaine: merged PR and updated changelog. closing thread — thanks everyone! :tada:
